author: K1tkat
quote: One, if not the best resident evil game so far, my top 3 rn. The graphics, amazing. Story amazing. Gameplay spectacular. Bosses and enemies are super cool. The dual pov's of leon and grace is so good. Grace's horror part is scary and Leon's action segments are just amazing. Let's not forget the nostalgia we get revisiting some key places in raccoon city. Overall,game is amazing. A must play.

author: K1tkat
quote:
After 13 years, this is what we were promised? The game is restrictive, filled with bugs & the only saving grace it has is its graphics which is only good if your console doesn't explode & the GPS stays stable. Rest of the game? Bad. Story? Mid, gameplay? Mid. Characters? Very bad especially Lucia. She's unbearable, bossy and annoying, Jason is..... A soft guy, no strong personality, terrible voice acting btw & just... Let's Lucia to boss him around.

This Game just showed everyone that letting go of people who knew the story if gta make such an impact, and more expensive games doesn't mean an amazing game. Plus a game where critics review a buggy, 30fps (& lower), mud story a 99/100 shouldn't be trusted till the players themselves played the game.
